instructor: This is my 6th semester in the department, and she was, by far, the most unqualified MBG instructor I have seen. She had absolutely no knowledge of the course topic. She clearly stated in the first class that she hates this course, and it is evident. It was obvious that she was learning with us. She was preparing lecture notes before the lectures, but she gave up halfway through this semester. Also, on some days, since she did not study the topic herself, we did some "activities" such as designing primers in Blast, which she did not teach us beforehand. And she did these activities during the last 20 minutes of class, and when we couldn't finish on time, she said,  You can upload it in a few minutes.  I am leaving, and have left. Despite this absurd way of teaching bioinformatics, she asked about 30 points worth of questions from this topic in the second midterm. This was a huge injustice for a curve-graded class, since there were people who were currently taking the bioinformatics class. When we tried to talk about this after the midterm, she got defensive and told us that she could ask for anything that was present on Moodle. She also said she can even ask physics questions if she wants. Also, at the beginning of the course, she said she would not get any attendance and would upload lecture videos to YouTube. However, when she saw we were not coming to class frequently, she began to make surprise bonus quizzes. Towards the end of the semester, she attempted to regain the authority she had lost by knowing nothing about the class, literally by threatening us with these "bonus" quizzes. She also cancelled the classes one hour before they were scheduled to start. In summary, I hope I will not have to take another course from her; it was a terrible self-learning experience.

The good thing is that she teaches only the important points you have to know in your life and career, she doesn’t really explain the things that are complicated or you won’t use in your career! This was smth good for me as an ADHD student who struggles with too much details.

Öncelikle açıp ders videolarını izlerseniz de görebilirsiniz ki kritik olan çok fazla konuyu, gerek maldi-tof gibi protein purification tekniği olsun gerek enzim kinetikleri, Gibb’s yasaları, protein yapısı ve arkasında yatan kimya vs.; hepsini ben bunları zaten bilmiyorum diyerek ya geçiyor ya da çok ama çok yüzeysel anlatıyordu.
